title: I just found this sub
content: And I’m not sure if this post is the right place. I resonate a lot with the mall, schools, airport terminals, apartments, and houses that I go back to in my dreams. I have been having this other area in my dream that’s like an amusement park / water park. It’s almost like Disney land but there’s some water slide type rides and everyone’s clothed and there are dry areas with rides too. This sometimes combines with my mall dream, like the rides are in the mall. And the mall is huge. Multiple escalators and ways to go.
